task_class: Bounded Python library maintenance at historical upstream revisions: API refactoring and bug fixes, with persistent source-linked memory across canonical code changes.

tasks.category: real upstream refactor exposing reusable HelpOption API; authored acceptance tests required
real upstream bug fix; upstream regression tests

heldout_selection.selection_basis: Two chronological specifier bug fixes in already available metadata, chosen before any task-model measurements. No performance-based replacement allowed.
heldout_selection.source_exposure: Packaging source was used in earlier structural research, so this is task/outcome-held-out, not a previously unseen project. Final task prompts/evaluator and implementation will be frozen before final model runs.
heldout_selection.unusable_task_rule: Record a failed preflight; do not substitute a task after observing model results. All final results preserved and implementation cannot be tuned against them.

sessions: New clean transcript per stage; persistent memory database across four stages, canonical source reset before every stage; model-generated patches never become subsequent task inputs.
order: Three cyclic arm orders over repetition blocks, stage index rotates initial arm; no concurrent model trials.
memory: Identical deterministic origin-source note catalog, shared retrieval and budget; static notes explicitly unchecked-current; CAMI source-linked notes withheld when current evidence requires review. No future task solutions in memory. Notes are not behavior-verified claims.
cold_scope: Fresh local OpenCode/MCP state and memory construction; remote provider cache cannot be forced cold and cached token fields must be recorded.
cost_boundary: Common source extraction charged identically; per-arm memory construction, capture, source CAS, SQLite durability, refresh, lookup, process startup, model calls, task tool runs, storage and cleanup measured. Initial build included in full four-stage sequence totals and cold task total; never amortized away without showing denominator. Infrastructure/auth preparation and evaluator cost separately recorded, never silently omitted.
primary_quality: All fixed task acceptance checks plus predefined regression suite pass; original tests restored for evaluation, agent modifications cannot weaken evaluator. Base must fail task acceptance and gold must pass before model runs.
staleness: Separate changed-source memory exposure, confirmed obsolete snippet exposure, and evidence-backed stale reliance in visible tool/action/final traces. Unknown reliance remains unknown. CAMI withholding is not itself task correctness; zero detected reliance is not proof of absence.
primary_efficiency: End-to-end sequence elapsed seconds and provider token fields, with memory setup included; report paired per-block values, medians, ranges and all failures. Provider cost metadata is not verified subscription billing.
success_rule: No quality degradation on the predefined final tasks and a consistent paired gain in full sequence elapsed time or non-cached provider token usage over all three repeated blocks against both comparison arms. With two task instances, no broad population claim or statistical proof of noninferiority.
failure_policy: Timeouts, provider errors, rejected permissions, tool errors and incomplete runs retained and reported. No silent retry/replacement; technical repair creates a new declared protocol/run version.
optimization: Development measurements only. Profile measured dominant costs before changes; no Rust rewrite unless a confirmed CPU bottleneck justifies it.
search_replacement: Exact symbol lookup does not satisfy native regex grep semantics; retain native search in primary arms. A separately labeled exact-symbol tool experiment requires its own compatibility and task protocol.
state_trajectory: Frozen semantic catalog content persists. CAMI maintenance states and caches produced by each arm's own tool calls persist across stages, including sticky manual-review states after temporary edits. Canonical source resets are identical before each task; agent solutions are not used as future source or memory payloads. This is an end-to-end policy effect, not a claim that all arms execute an identical internal state trajectory.
memory_seed_policy: All unambiguous direct public Python functions and methods plus __init__/__call__ from source roots; one deterministic source-only note per selector, unique global note key, first2400 source characters. No task-target filtering, max1024 records safety bound. Seed source extraction charged per arm.
native_search_compatibility: CAMI find supports exact symbol selectors; native OpenCode grep supports arbitrary regex text matches and line/path results. These contracts differ, so no direct replacement is included or mislabeled as equivalent. A complementary symbol tool can be a separate later experiment.
historical_task_limitations: Public historical tasks may be present in model training. No claim of contamination-free benchmark. Same fixed model and prompts across arms, no upstream history/solutions available in task filesystem, network use prohibited in task prompts and native web tools disabled.
